description: WITH DEBUGGING MODE clause (SOURCE-COMPUTER) — the '85 debug module's compile-time switch: it keeps the program's fixed-form debugging lines (indicator D) as source (DebuggingLineRewriter, kb/Work PB1705, owner decision R56). Owner decision kb/Work R61 (researched against GnuCOBOL's per-standard dialect files, debugging-mode: ok at 85, obsolete at 2002, unconformable at 2014): accepted at 85, OBSOLETE at 2002 (the obsolete-element warning COBOL0903), REMOVED at 2014 (COBOL0902, error strict / warning permissive). Medium confidence on the 2002/2014 edge (the ISO 2002 and 2014 texts are not in the repository). Gated at the modelled debuggingModeClause (P2.6; kb/Work PB830). Companion of debugging-line-removed-2014; USE FOR DEBUGGING keeps its own row.
citation: the '85 debug module's switch (§1985:XV.2.1.2, REMOVED); obsolete 2002, removed 2014; VCR Table 7 row 7.9
